text: Added VerifiedResultPayload and VerifiedAttachment. attachFileVerified performs the sole bounded read and attachVerified the sole decode/validation; payload retains exact immutable value bytes, full durable bindings, validated outputs, and evidence. Sojourn stores payload.encodedValue directly and contains no ResultEnvelopeCodec.decode or result-file reread. Evidence: ResultAttachmentSuite 8/8 including binding and post-attachment replacement; Sojourn slurm compile green; canonical compatibility attach APIs retained.
